threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the Tube instead of just the ‘underground’ and you’re baffled by how locals navigate the delays with a shrug.
Caught a guy on the 343 last night singing Wham! at the top of his lungs. Even the driver couldn’t help but smile. Only in Peckham!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the late-night kebab shop ran out of bread and the owner apologized like it was his fault. You just don’t get that anywhere else.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, you'll find spontaneous street festivals where locals set up food stalls and dance parties on just another Saturday. It's electrifying!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they’re from here if they know the shortcut through the alley to avoid the BART delays. The tourists just stand there confused.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy trying to enter a Muni bus carrying a giant inflatable unicorn. Driver just shook his head, but the passengers loved it.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they know the best tapas spots, but they miss out on the hidden gems tucked away on quiet streets, like Cal Pep's little sister.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can often spot them at the market, struggling with the weight of their fresh produce while trying to decipher the Catalan labels.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You think checking the Tube status app will save you time during a strike. It won’t. You'll learn to live by bus schedules and street signs instead.
Caught the 59 last night; two guys were having a full debate over the best chicken spot in Brixton. Almost missed my stop listening in.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the kebab vendor remembered my order and joked about the weather. That’s when I knew Neukölln had wrapped itself around me.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find Döner kebab shops doubling as late-night bars, complete with DJs spinning from behind the counter. Now that's multitasking.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know that the taco trucks around 24th and Mission close before it gets dark. Newbies think they can grab a bite late night.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 21 this morning, it stopped for a full five minutes because a man wanted to finish his conversation with the driver. Classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is all about Gaudí, but they miss the quiet squares where locals argue about football over a caña.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still asking for directions to places like El Xampanyet, not realizing it’s barely a five-minute walk from Plaça del Sol.
